questions.prompt: You should __________ to your classmate for speaking so rudely.
questions.explanation: 语法上，should 后接动词原形，apologize 作动词。语义上，说话粗鲁后应该向同学道歉。固定搭配：apologize to someone for something。

questions.prompt: The project cannot begin without official __________ from the school.
questions.explanation: 语法上，official 修饰名词，approval 表示“批准”。语义上，项目开始前需要学校正式批准。常见搭配：official approval。

questions.prompt: He tried to __________ the last seat before anyone else saw it.
questions.explanation: 语法上，tried to 后接动词原形，grab 表示“抓住，抢占”。语义上，他想在别人看到前抢到最后一个座位。

questions.prompt: This ticket will __________ you to a free drink at the café.
questions.explanation: 语法上，will 后接动词原形，entitle 表示“给予权利”。语义上，这张票让你有资格获得免费饮料。固定搭配：entitle someone to something。

questions.prompt: Could you __________ me your dictionary until tomorrow morning?
questions.explanation: 语法上，Could you 后接动词原形，lend 表示“借出”。语义上，请别人把词典借给自己。注意：lend me your dictionary 是“借给我”，不是“向我借”。

questions.prompt: Her __________ in the drama club improved her confidence greatly.
questions.explanation: 语法上，Her 后接名词，involvement 表示“参与”。语义上，参加戏剧社提升了她的自信。常见搭配：involvement in。

questions.prompt: Too much sun __________ can damage your skin badly.
questions.explanation: 语法上，sun 修饰名词，exposure 表示“暴露，接触”。语义上，过度晒太阳会伤害皮肤。常见搭配：sun exposure。

questions.prompt: Many young people prefer online lessons to __________ classroom teaching.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰 classroom teaching，需要形容词。语义上，年轻人更喜欢线上课，而不是传统课堂教学。

questions.prompt: The school uses a __________ system to record students’ homework.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰 system，需要形容词。语义上，学校使用数字系统记录作业。

questions.prompt: Can you __________ this paragraph from Chinese into English?
questions.explanation: 语法上，Can you 后接动词原形。语义上，把中文段落翻译成英文。固定搭配：translate A from Chinese into English。

questions.prompt: Please __________ your essay before you hand it in tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 语法上，Please 后接动词原形。语义上，交作文前需要编辑、修改文章。

questions.prompt: The __________ of good habits takes time and patience.
questions.explanation: 语法上，The 后接名词，formation 表示“形成”。语义上，好习惯的形成需要时间和耐心。常见搭配：the formation of habits。

questions.prompt: You must pay a small __________ before renting the apartment.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a small 后接可数名词单数。语义上，租房前需要支付一小笔押金。

questions.prompt: We had a __________ conversation during the long train journey.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰 conversation，需要形容词。语义上，旅途中进行了一次愉快的交谈。

questions.prompt: My cousin is studying __________ at a university in Canada.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格作副词，修饰 studying。语义上，表兄弟正在加拿大海外学习。常见搭配：study overseas。

questions.prompt: Many doctors __________ more exercise and less junk food.
questions.explanation: 语法上，主语 Many doctors 后接谓语动词原形。语义上，医生提倡多运动、少吃垃圾食品。

questions.prompt: The __________ of the new school took almost three years.
questions.explanation: 语法上，The 后接名词。语义上，新学校的建立用了将近三年。常见搭配：the establishment of。

questions.prompt: Write a short __________ of the article in your own words.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a short 后接名词。语义上，用自己的话写文章摘要。常见搭配：a summary of the article。

questions.prompt: This is only a __________ plan, so we can still change it.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰 plan，需要形容词。语义上，这只是粗略计划，还可以修改。

questions.prompt: She used a black __________ to sign the agreement.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a black 后接名词。语义上，她用黑色钢笔签署协议。

questions.prompt: His __________ after the surgery was slower than expected.
questions.explanation: 语法上，His 后接名词。语义上，手术后的恢复比预期更慢。常见搭配：recovery after surgery。

questions.prompt: Make sure you __________ the bottle tightly after using it.
questions.explanation: 语法上，Make sure you 后接动词原形。语义上，用完后要把瓶子密封好。

questions.prompt: The scientist placed the liquid inside a glass __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a glass 后接名词。语义上，科学家把液体放进玻璃管中。常见搭配：test tube / glass tube。

questions.prompt: The old stone __________ stands above the whole town.
questions.explanation: 语法上，The old stone 后接名词。语义上，古老石塔矗立在小镇上方。

questions.prompt: Bright colors and simple shapes __________ her early paintings.
questions.explanation: 语法上，主语是复数 Bright colors and simple shapes，后接动词原形。语义上，明亮色彩和简单形状是她早期绘画的特征。

questions.prompt: Please __________ the exact date of your arrival.
questions.explanation: 语法上，Please 后接动词原形。语义上，要求对方具体说明到达日期。常见搭配：specify the date / time / details。

questions.prompt: I need the __________ address, not just the street name.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰 address，需要形容词。语义上，需要精确地址，而不只是街道名。

questions.prompt: The wheels began to __________ faster on the wet road.
questions.explanation: 语法上，began to 后接动词原形。语义上，车轮在湿路上开始更快旋转。

questions.prompt: The machine __________ stopped production after noticing smoke.
questions.explanation: 语法上，The machine 修饰名词 operator。语义上，机器操作员看到烟后停止生产。

questions.prompt: The young mother held her sleeping __________ carefully.
questions.explanation: 语法上，her sleeping 后接名词。语义上，年轻母亲小心抱着熟睡的婴儿。

questions.prompt: The children helped their parents __________ holes for new trees.
questions.explanation: 语法上，helped their parents 后可接动词原形，dig 表示“挖”。语义上，孩子们帮助父母挖树坑。

questions.prompt: Please do not __________ the chair across the wooden floor.
questions.explanation: 语法上，do not 后接动词原形。语义上，不要把椅子在木地板上拖来拖去。

questions.prompt: The climbers began to __________ the hill before sunrise.
questions.explanation: 语法上，began to 后接动词原形。语义上，登山者天亮前开始登上小山。

questions.prompt: You should __________ the gift carefully before the party.
questions.explanation: 语法上，should 后接动词原形。语义上，派对前应该把礼物包好。

questions.prompt: We __________ heavy traffic during the holiday weekend.
questions.explanation: 语法上，主语 We 后接谓语动词。语义上，预计假期周末会交通拥堵。

questions.prompt: Young children are usually __________ on adults for safety.
questions.explanation: 语法上，are 后接形容词。语义上，儿童通常依赖成年人保证安全。固定搭配：be dependent on。

questions.prompt: Some doctors __________ in heart disease and serious operations.
questions.explanation: 语法上，主语 Some doctors 后接动词原形。语义上，有些医生专攻心脏病和重大手术。固定搭配：specialize in。

questions.prompt: Hold the camera at a better __________ for the photo.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a better 后接名词。语义上，为了拍照，需要以更好的角度拿相机。

questions.prompt: We had rice and __________ for lunch at school.
questions.explanation: 语法上，rice and 后接名词。语义上，午餐吃了米饭和鸡肉。

questions.prompt: Exam pressure can cause serious __________ in some teenagers.
questions.explanation: 语法上，serious 修饰名词。语义上，考试压力会造成严重焦虑。

questions.prompt: The computer __________ spread quickly through the school network.
questions.explanation: 语法上，The computer 修饰名词 virus。语义上，电脑病毒在学校网络中快速传播。

questions.prompt: The meeting will start __________ at nine o’clock tomorrow.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰时间表达 at nine o’clock，需要副词。语义上，会议会在九点整准时开始。

questions.prompt: Their main __________ sells similar products at lower prices.
questions.explanation: 语法上，Their main 后接名词。语义上，主要竞争对手以更低价格销售类似产品。

questions.prompt: Driving without a licence is a serious __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a serious 后接名词。语义上，无证驾驶是一种严重违法行为。

questions.prompt: This device can __________ smoke before people notice danger.
questions.explanation: 语法上，情态动词 can 后接动词原形。语义上，设备能在人们发现危险前侦测烟雾。

questions.prompt: As a __________, he often argues with his parents.
questions.explanation: 语法上，As a 后接名词。语义上，作为青少年，他经常和父母争论。

questions.prompt: I really __________ people who keep learning after failure.
questions.explanation: 语法上，主语 I 后接谓语动词。语义上，我钦佩那些失败后仍继续学习的人。

questions.prompt: Doctors suggest __________ exercise for older adults.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰 exercise，需要形容词。语义上，医生建议老年人进行适度运动。常见搭配：moderate exercise。

questions.prompt: She needed knee __________ after the skiing accident.
questions.explanation: 语法上，knee 修饰名词 surgery。语义上，滑雪事故后她需要膝盖手术。

questions.prompt: The young __________ played guitar beautifully on stage.
questions.explanation: 语法上，The young 后接名词。语义上，年轻音乐家在舞台上优美地弹吉他。

questions.prompt: Few people understood the full __________ of the discovery at first.
questions.explanation: 语法上，the full 后接名词。语义上，起初很少有人理解这个发现的全部意义。常见搭配：the significance of。

questions.prompt: I usually take a quick __________ after basketball practice.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a quick 后接名词。语义上，篮球训练后通常快速冲个澡。常见搭配：take a shower。

questions.prompt: It is __________ to sell alcohol to children in many countries.
questions.explanation: 语法上，It is 后接形容词。语义上，在许多国家，向儿童卖酒是违法的。

questions.prompt: The students raised money for a local __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a local 后接名词。语义上，学生为当地慈善机构筹款。

questions.prompt: A smile is often described as a __________ sign of friendliness.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰 sign，需要形容词。语义上，微笑常被视为友好的普遍信号。

questions.prompt: He lit a __________ outside the restaurant after dinner.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a 后接可数名词单数。语义上，晚饭后他在餐厅外点了一支香烟。

questions.prompt: Women __________ more than half of the club’s members.
questions.explanation: 语法上，主语 Women 后接谓语动词原形。语义上，女性构成了俱乐部成员的一半以上。

questions.prompt: The room was small but __________ for one person.
questions.explanation: 语法上，was 后接形容词。语义上，房间虽小，但对一个人来说足够。

questions.prompt: The company hired a financial __________ to reduce costs.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a financial 后接名词。语义上，公司雇佣财务顾问来降低成本。

questions.prompt: The __________ studied letters written during the war.
questions.explanation: 语法上，The 后接名词。语义上，历史学家研究战争时期写的信件。

questions.prompt: My __________ lives in Hong Kong and visits us often.
questions.explanation: 语法上，My 后接名词。语义上，我的表兄弟/堂兄弟住在香港，经常来看我们。

questions.prompt: Charts provide useful __________ support for difficult ideas.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰 support，需要形容词。语义上，图表为难懂概念提供视觉支持。

questions.prompt: It was __________ to leave your passport on the bus.
questions.explanation: 语法上，It was 后接形容词。语义上，把护照落在公交车上很愚蠢。

questions.prompt: She is __________ to join the school debate team.
questions.explanation: 语法上，is 后接形容词。语义上，她渴望加入学校辩论队。固定搭配：be keen to do something。

questions.prompt: The city has restaurants from many different __________ groups.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰 groups，需要形容词。语义上，城市里有来自许多不同民族群体的餐馆。

questions.prompt: His __________ brother looks almost exactly like him.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰 brother，表示“双胞胎的”。语义上，他的双胞胎兄弟几乎和他一模一样。

questions.prompt: The medicine is still being tested in __________ trials.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰 trials，需要形容词。语义上，这种药仍在临床试验中。常见搭配：clinical trials。

questions.prompt: The storm moved across the __________ part of the country.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰 part，需要形容词。语义上，风暴穿过了该国东部地区。

questions.prompt: The weather __________ says it will rain this afternoon.
questions.explanation: 语法上，The weather 修饰名词 forecast。语义上，天气预报说今天下午会下雨。

questions.prompt: The final __________ of the show was the most exciting.
questions.explanation: 语法上，The final 后接名词。语义上，节目的最后一个片段最精彩。

questions.prompt: Bowing is an old __________ in some Asian countries.
questions.explanation: 语法上，an old 后接名词。语义上，鞠躬在一些亚洲国家是古老习俗。

questions.prompt: New students need time to __________ to school life.
questions.explanation: 语法上，need time to 后接动词原形。语义上，新生需要时间适应学校生活。固定搭配：adapt to。

questions.prompt: The children built a castle from wet __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，wet 修饰名词 sand。语义上，孩子们用湿沙建城堡。

questions.prompt: Wear a __________ to protect your head from the sun.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a 后接可数名词单数。语义上，戴帽子可以保护头部免受太阳照射。

questions.prompt: His careless words may __________ an angry response.
questions.explanation: 语法上，情态动词 may 后接动词原形。语义上，他粗心的话可能引发愤怒反应。

questions.prompt: The village has a quiet __________ that attracts many visitors.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a quiet 后接名词。语义上，村庄有一种安静的魅力，吸引游客。

questions.prompt: How did your parents __________ when they heard the news?
questions.explanation: 语法上，助动词 did 后接动词原形。语义上，问父母听到消息后如何反应。固定搭配：react to。

questions.prompt: The professor gave a __________ on climate change.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a 后接名词。语义上，教授做了一场关于气候变化的讲座。常见搭配：give a lecture on。

questions.prompt: Starting a small business is always a risky __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a risky 后接名词。语义上，创业总是一个有风险的项目。

questions.prompt: Water is a chemical __________ because it contains hydrogen and oxygen.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a chemical 后接名词，compound 表示“化合物”。语义上，水由氢和氧组成，因此是化学化合物。这里按题目句意考查 compound 的“化合物”。

questions.prompt: Firefighters worked all night to __________ people from the building.
questions.explanation: 语法上，to 后接动词原形。语义上，消防员整夜营救楼里的人。

questions.prompt: Your room is a complete __________, so clean it now.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a complete 后接名词。语义上，房间非常乱，所以需要清理。

questions.prompt: I have a strong __________ for tea rather than coffee.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a strong 后接名词。语义上，比起咖啡，我更偏爱茶。固定搭配：a preference for。

questions.prompt: The report gives a __________ view of the whole problem.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰 view，需要形容词。语义上，报告全面展示了整个问题。

questions.prompt: Extra marks can be a useful __________ for lazy students.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a useful 后接名词。语义上，额外分数可作为激励懒散学生的有效手段。

questions.prompt: Our school team joined a local basketball __________.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a local basketball 后接名词。语义上，校队加入了当地篮球联赛。

questions.prompt: The film includes a short __________ between father and son.
questions.explanation: 语法上，a short 后接名词。语义上，电影包含父子之间的一段简短对话。

questions.prompt: She added some __________ to the soup before serving it.
questions.explanation: 语法上，some 后接不可数名词。语义上，她在上菜前往汤里加了一些奶油。

questions.prompt: The company has seen __________ growth in online sales.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰 growth，需要形容词。语义上，公司线上销售增长迅速。常见搭配：rapid growth。

questions.prompt: They had to __________ the trip because of the storm.
questions.explanation: 语法上，had to 后接动词原形。语义上，因为暴风雨，他们不得不取消旅行。

questions.prompt: I deeply __________ wasting so much time last year.
questions.explanation: 语法上，主语 I 后接谓语动词。语义上，我非常后悔去年浪费那么多时间。固定搭配：regret doing something。

questions.prompt: The manager decided to __________ him for repeated lateness.
questions.explanation: 语法上，decided to 后接动词原形。语义上，经理决定因他多次迟到而解雇他。

questions.prompt: Write your notes in the left __________ of the page.
questions.explanation: 语法上，the left 后接名词。语义上，把笔记写在页面左边空白处。常见搭配：the margin of the page。

questions.prompt: The cat was hiding __________ the old wooden table.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格后接名词短语，需介词。语义上，猫藏在旧木桌下面。

questions.prompt: Her strongest __________ in the final match was from Japan.
questions.explanation: 语法上，Her strongest 后接名词。语义上，她决赛中最强的对手来自日本。

questions.prompt: Children often find it hard to __________ sweet snacks.
questions.explanation: 语法上，find it hard to 后接动词原形。语义上，孩子常觉得很难抵抗甜食诱惑。

questions.prompt: This phone has the __________ to take excellent photos.
questions.explanation: 语法上，the 后接名词。语义上，这部手机有拍出优秀照片的能力。固定搭配：the capability to do something。

questions.prompt: There is __________ silence in the room after the bad news.
questions.explanation: 语法上，空格修饰 silence，需要形容词。语义上，坏消息之后房间里一片绝对安静。

questions.prompt: These figures do not __________ with the numbers in your report.
questions.explanation: 语法上，do not 后接动词原形。语义上，这些数据和报告中的数字不一致。固定搭配：correspond with。

questions.prompt: The swimmer improved his back __________ before the competition.
questions.explanation: 语法上，his back 修饰名词 stroke。语义上，游泳运动员在比赛前改进了仰泳划水动作。常见搭配：back stroke / swimming stroke。
